Mumbai
Open to relocating to Kolkata or Delhi NCR. Notice period: 90 days.

Professional Summary
Data-focused analyst with strong background in deriving actionable insights from large datasets, building automated reporting, and supporting product and operations decisions. Skilled at translating business questions into analytical approaches, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering data products that improve process efficiency and revenue outcomes.

Technical Skills
SQL, Python, PowerBI, Statistics, Google Analytics, Agile, Linux, Git

Work Experience

Senior Data Analyst, Helio Energy (Feb 2017 - Present)
- Built and maintained SQL-driven ETL pipelines and reporting views to aggregate meter and operations data, enabling monthly KPI dashboards that reduced manual report generation time by 60% (SQL, PowerBI).
- Designed A/B test frameworks and applied Statistics to evaluate pricing and maintenance interventions, producing statistically significant uplift analyses used to prioritize rollouts (Statistics, SQL).
- Implemented Google Analytics tracking and dashboards to correlate customer portal behavior with on-site service requests, leading to a 12% reduction in churn through targeted UX changes (Google Analytics, Python).
- Automated recurring data workflows on Linux servers and managed version-controlled scripts in Git to streamline deployment of analytics jobs (Linux, Git, Python).

Business Analyst, Covalent Infotech (Aug 2013 - Jan 2017)
- Developed SQL queries and data models to support client reporting needs, reducing report turnaround from days to hours and improving data accuracy for billing and usage reports (SQL).
- Performed statistical analyses to identify trends and outliers in client datasets, informing operational improvements and SLA renegotiations that improved on-time delivery metrics (Statistics).
- Built Python scripts to clean and transform disparate input files and integrated outputs into PowerBI dashboards for stakeholders, enabling real-time monitoring of key business metrics (Python, PowerBI).
- Collaborated in Agile teams to define requirements and deliver incremental enhancements to analytics products, maintaining code in Git and deploying on Linux-based environments (Agile, Git, Linux).

Education
BBA, Christ University
